The issuer shows relatively strong profitability (net income margin ~19% and ROE ~12%), but its capital structure is very leveraged: equity is only about 15% of assets (equity/assets ≈ 3,328/21,779) with liabilities comprising ~80% of the balance sheet. The thin equity cushion, together with retained earnings that exceed reported equity (suggesting negative offsets in other equity components), indicates higher balance-sheet risk, supporting a speculative-grade outcome.

DECISION: BB-
